full_prompt_en: A square abstract geometric print sits on a warm off-white paper ground, with a compact arrangement of overlapping colored planes placed slightly off center. The composition is decisively asymmetrical: a tall mustard-yellow block fills much of the upper left, while a bright cyan-blue block answers it at the upper right. Across the lower half, a darker marine-blue rectangle enters from the left, and a deep teal-green rectangle spreads toward the right, leaving small irregular margins of bare paper around the arrangement. A long narrow vermilion rectangle descends just right of center, crossing several color boundaries and acting as the strongest vertical accent. On the left, a small red circle rests along the top edge of the dark blue plane. On the right, a much larger navy circle overlaps the cyan field, the red strip, and a warm yellow side band. Its lower half becomes brighter blue where a translucent horizontal layer cuts through it. A very thin dark rule passes horizontally across the middle and a hairline vertical rule stands near the upper center, adding delicate measured tension to the solid blocks. At the lower right, a quarter-circle of unprinted paper cuts into the yellow edge. The color fields are opaque in some places and visibly translucent where they overlap, creating green, orange, and deep blue intersections. Fine paper grain and slightly uneven ink density keep the forms tactile rather than digitally pristine. Light is flat and even, with no cast shadows; contrast comes from the collision of warm saturated planes, cool blue weight, and exposed ivory. The whole image feels carefully balanced without symmetry, its large right circle and central red bar held against the smaller left circle and staggered rectangles.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形抽象几何版画铺在暖灰白纸底上，一组叠置色面略偏中心地紧凑排布。构图明确不对称：高大的芥黄块占据左上大部，明亮青蓝块在右上回应它。下半部，一块更深的海蓝矩形从左侧进入，深青绿色矩形向右铺开，让色块周围留下不规则的小片裸纸。狭长朱红矩形在中心略偏右处向下延伸，跨过数道色彩边界，成为最强的竖向点缀。左侧一枚小红圆停在深蓝色面的上缘。右侧一枚大得多的海军蓝圆形叠在青蓝色域、红色条带与暖黄色侧带上。它的下半部被半透明水平层切过，转为更亮的蓝色。一道极细暗线横穿中部，一道发丝般的竖线立在靠近上方中心的位置，为厚实色块增添精细而有分寸的张力。右下角，一块未印刷的四分之一圆纸白切进黄色边缘。色域有些地方不透明，叠压处则明显半透明，生出绿色、橙色和深蓝交界。细纸纹与轻微不匀的墨量让形体有触感，而非数字般无瑕。光线平整均匀，没有投影；对比来自暖饱和色面、冷蓝重量与裸露象牙白的碰撞。整幅画精确平衡却不对称，以右侧大圆与中央红条牵制左侧小圆及错落矩形。
style_prompt_en: A tactile geometric print assembles broad flat rectangles and unequal circles in an offset, asymmetrical cluster on warm ivory paper. Mustard yellow and vermilion provide warm thrusts against cyan, marine blue, navy, and dark teal, with exposed paper left visible as an active border. Several planes are opaque, while others overlap transparently to form secondary green, orange, and blue intersections. Thin black rules cross the solid masses horizontally and vertically, creating a precise linear counter-rhythm to the large areas. Fine paper tooth and subtle ink mottling remain visible within each color field, and edges are mostly crisp with slight print-like softness. A larger dark circular mass on one side balances a smaller warm circle on the opposite side; tall and low rectangles stagger rather than align into a centered grid. The lighting is neutral and flat, so color area, overlap, edge, and scale carry all of the depth. The overall image feels measured and lively, turning unequal weights into stable visual tension.
style_prompt_zh: 有触感的几何版画在暖象牙纸上把宽阔平面矩形与大小不等的圆组成偏置、不对称的簇群。芥黄与朱红形成暖色冲力，对照青蓝、海蓝、海军蓝与深青绿；裸纸作为积极的边界保留可见。有些色面不透明，另一些透明叠加，在交界处生成次级绿色、橙色与蓝色。细黑直线横向和竖向穿过厚实色块，与大面积形成精确的线性对拍。每片色域中仍可见细纸纹与轻微斑驳墨迹，边缘大多清晰，却带一点版印式柔软。一侧较大的深暗圆形体量与对侧较小的暖色圆相平衡；高低矩形错列，而不对齐成居中的网格。光线中性而平坦，因此色彩面积、叠压、边缘与尺度承担所有纵深。整体形象有分寸而活跃，把不等的重量变成稳定的视觉张力。
theme_en: An asymmetrical abstract print of overlapping primary-color rectangles and circles
theme_zh: 原色矩形与圆形不对称叠置的抽象版画
name: Asymmetrical composition
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
